verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Notebooks, a web-based Jupyter IDE backed by accelerated compute, so browser Jupyter access is a first-party capability. IDE access to Machines is only documented as generic SSH with your own key, and one community user reports SSH access on Core VMs was hard to get. missing for 10: documented one-click/one-step launch of Jupyter on a Machine instance, first-party VS Code/Cursor remote integration, evidence that connecting takes a single step, independent hands-on corroboration of smooth access.
